bootstrap.empty_resample_category: absent classes contribute zero delta; unlike rerunning TAO class selection on resampled data
bootstrap.limitation: 26/35 novel classes occur in one GT video; about 10 novel classes are absent per ordinary video resample. Their deltas shrink toward zero. This interval cannot establish across-video class generalization or serve as a significance gate.
bootstrap.scope: exploratory empirical video-composition perturbation interval; deterministic per-class deltas and support are primary evidence
